The pipeline consists of 7 sequential st: The pipeline consists of 7 sequential stages: detect(), extract(), build_graph(), cluster(), analyze(), report(), and export().
Each stage communicates through plain Py: Each stage communicates through plain Python dicts and NetworkX graphs with no shared state and no side effects outside the graphify-out/ directory.

Module-top-level indirect_call sources a: Module-top-level indirect_call sources and bash source/script-invocation targets that minted a node id from an absolute path are canonicalized to the root-relative node id in graph.json.
